verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is Ente's CLI, which is documented only for exporting and backing up Auth codes. That is a narrow export utility, not an API covering what the UI does: adding, editing, deleting, sharing, tagging, notes, trash and lock settings. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, so there is no evidence of UI-equivalent API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
